definitions: A structure, often found in obstacle courses or playgrounds, designed in the shape of a pyramid that participants must climb over or around.
A metaphorical representation of a series of challenges or difficulties arranged in a hierarchical or progressively more difficult manner.
examples: The children scrambled up the obstacle pyramid.
The final challenge of the race was a towering obstacle pyramid.
He viewed his career path as an obstacle pyramid, with each promotion a new peak to conquer.
